notes: §2002:13.16.43.2 SR2 requires a record's RENAMES entries to immediately follow its last entry: a 66 entry for record A written after record B under a CD is refused at --std 2002 (COBOL1655 at the 66 line), a mid-record 66 entry in working storage is refused (COBOL2740), and entries written right after their record are accepted (g2-renames-thru-cd-and-ws matched).
